_comment: monsters.json - THE source of truth for every monster (stats, levels, looks, special attacks); tune here. Levels: each spawn rolls a level from level_min..level_max (spawn files don't set levels); health and damage are for 'level' and scale by Data/combat_balance.json monster_hp_per_level / monster_damage_per_level for each level above or below it. Fields: description (shown name), level / level_min / level_max, health, damage, armor_class, speed, xp_gain, coin_modifier, category (animal/insect/reptile/humanoid/undead/elemental: category loot table, undead never flee), faction (monsters of one faction help each other; 'None' = on their own), behavior_type (aggressive / skitter / neutral = aggro at half range / passive = stays put, aggro at a third; aggro_range 0 = only fights back), is_social (calls nearby allies), aggro_range, flees (false = fights to the death), is_boss, zone (where it lives), special_ability (appraisal text), resistances / weaknesses, attack_verbs, death_text, secret_note, language. on_hit_effect {name, chance, tick_damage, tick_interval, duration, modifiers, message}: an ailment a landed hit may leave (names: weak_poison, strong_poison, weakening_venom, disease, grave_miasma, withering_touch, bleeding, sundered_armor, crippled, blinded, dazed; modifiers such as speed_slow, hit_chance, damage_mult, armor_bonus). Looks: a monster with its own model is listed in monster3d.gd; any other borrows one with model_from (+ model_scale, tint [r,g,b]). kill_standing {"Djhanid Clans": -15}: standing changes for whoever gets the kill (factions.json thresholds: at or below hostile_threshold that faction's monsters attack you on sight; at or above friendly_threshold they're allies). wary: true = never attacks first unless your standing makes that faction hate you (the Djhanid). abilities [...]: what a monster casts or does in a fight (see monster3d.gd Abilities section: nuke, debuff, aoe, heal, summon, enrage). summoned_only: only ever called by another monster (no spawn point). loot_from: use that monster's loot table (Data/solgrave_expanse_loot.json) until it has its own. Where they spawn: Data/<zone>_spawns.json.

dustwalker_warlord.special_ability: Sundering Blow (armour); calls raiders; war frenzy at low health.

on_hit_effect.name: dazed
on_hit_effect.message: %s's mandibles slam you off your feet!

on_hit_effect.name: weakening_venom
on_hit_effect.message: %s's barb leaves a weakening venom in you!

sandshifter.special_ability: Half sand, half crystal: blades bite less (resists physical). Scours you with sand.

bonegnawer.secret_note: Gnolls of the Bonegnawer clan, driven out of the Kragthar warrens by something worse below.

sunmaddened_wanderer.special_ability: Casts Arcanist spells (monsters don't cast yet)

dessik_coinhand.special_ability: Dirty tricks: coins in your eyes (blind); whistles for a bandit when hurt.

abilities.name: Dirty Trick
abilities.message: %s flings a fistful of coins in your eyes!

dessik_coinhand.death_text: Dessik Coinhand collapses in the sand, one hand still closed around a purse that is no longer there.
dessik_coinhand.secret_note: A brigand who robs by the ledger: he stripped a Lumoran wagon of its strongbox and has kept it close, on his belt, ever since.

rask_ironjaw.special_ability: Skull Crack (dazes); flies into a rage when badly hurt.

abilities.name: Iron Rage
abilities.message: %s spits out a tooth and roars!

rask_ironjaw.death_text: Rask Ironjaw goes down on one knee, then all the way, and the camp goes very quiet.
rask_ironjaw.secret_note: Captain of the sand brigands. The other bandits fight harder when he is close; the ones that flee are running toward him, not away.

grukka_bonechewer.special_ability: Casts Bone Shard; gnaws a bone to heal (stun it!); calls goblins when losing.

abilities.name: Bone Shard
abilities.message: A shard of bone from %s tears into you!

abilities.name: Marrow Feast
abilities.message: %s gnaws a bone and its wounds knit shut!

abilities.name: Goblin Horn
abilities.message: %s blows a cracked horn: goblins come running!

grukka_bonechewer.death_text: Grukka Bonechewer topples, and the bones on his belt clatter out across the sand like dropped dice.
grukka_bonechewer.secret_note: Chieftain of the goblin camps. The bones he wears are trophies, and some of them are too big to be goblin.

abilities.name: Grave Command
abilities.message: %s's hollow voice orders you to kneel, and your hands shake!

abilities.name: Rally the Fallen
abilities.message: %s bellows a muster call and the dead answer!

sergeant_halvek.special_ability: Grave Command (terrifies); raises a dead soldier.
sergeant_halvek.secret_note: A Warden who died holding this road and never stopped holding it. Whatever kept him standing is not rest.
sergeant_halvek.death_text: Sergeant Halvek comes apart at last, and for a moment the bones lie in the shape of a salute.

abilities.name: The Den Stirs
abilities.message: %s shrieks: broodlings pour from the silk!

weavemother_vhessa.special_ability: Ensnaring Web (root); Poison Bite; broodlings pour out when she's hurt.
weavemother_vhessa.death_text: Weavemother Vhessa curls in on herself, legs drawing shut like a fist, and the whole den seems to let go of a held breath.
weavemother_vhessa.secret_note: The silk on her back is stitched with a mark that no spider makes: a closed eye over three drops, the sign of the Moribund Order.

on_hit_effect.name: grave_miasma
on_hit_effect.message: The grave's miasma rolls off %s and sickens you!

djhanid_sand_walker.special_ability: Casts Spiritwalker spells (monsters don't cast yet)

on_hit_effect.name: strong_poison
on_hit_effect.message: %s's barb pumps a lethal venom into you!

spider_broodmother.special_ability: Strong poison; webs; keeps calling broodlings.

broodling.special_ability: Called by broodmothers (Weavemother Vhessa, the spider broodmother); never spawns on its own.

risen_priest.special_ability: Casts Lightsworn spells (monsters don't cast yet)

abilities.name: Silence of the Tomb
abilities.message: The tomb's silence closes your throat!

tomb_guardian.special_ability: Casts Void Bolt and Silence of the Tomb (interrupt them); phantom blades strike everyone near.

on_hit_effect.name: sundered_armor
on_hit_effect.message: %s's phantom blade passes through your armour!

grave_abomination.special_ability: Miasma Belch (disease, everyone near); feeds on corpses to heal (interrupt it!); frenzies near death.

abilities.name: Miasma Belch
abilities.say: %s heaves out a cloud of grave-rot!

abilities.name: Corpse Feast
abilities.message: %s tears at the dead stitched into it and grows whole!

bonegnawer_hunter.special_ability: Throws a bola that hobbles you (snare).

bonegnawer_shaman.special_ability: Casts Rot Hex (poison) and Sluggish Blood (slow); mends its wounds.

abilities.name: Sluggish Blood
abilities.message: Your blood runs thick and slow!

abilities.name: Gnaw Mend
abilities.message: %s chews a root and its wounds close!

mirage_phantom.special_ability: Casts Dread Mirage (terrifies); hard to pin down.

abilities.name: Dread Mirage
abilities.message: Your worst memory rises from %s's shimmer!

tomb_skeleton.special_ability: Old soldiers of the mass grave: they fight in ranks.

wight.special_ability: Casts Life Tap and Grave Chill (slows).

abilities.name: Grave Chill
abilities.message: %s's touch chills you to the bone!

takmajir_scout.special_ability: Drow spies from Xul-Dura: quick blades.

takmajir_ritualist.special_ability: Casts Shadow Lance and Veil of Doubt (curse).

dustwalker_defiler.special_ability: Chaos-touched caster: Drain Life, and raises a skeleton.

abilities.name: Raise Thrall
abilities.message: %s drags a skeleton up out of the sand!

djhanid_guardian.special_ability: Honour-bound spear of the clans; wary of strangers.

djhanid_tracker.special_ability: Pins you with a glass-tipped arrow (snare).

djhanid_spiritist.special_ability: Calls on the sand spirits: Spirit Lash, and heals.

abilities.name: Spirit Lash
abilities.message: The sand spirits lash you at %s's call!

abilities.name: Waters of the Clan
abilities.message: %s pours water on the sand and is made whole!

sandshifter_elite.special_ability: Group: shard trail hits everyone near; grinds your armour away.

abilities.name: Shard Storm
abilities.say: %s bursts into a storm of crystal shards!

sandshifter_alpha.special_ability: Rare group boss: Shard Storm, Sand Fade (hard to hit), calls sandshifters.

phantom_lord.special_ability: Group boss of the Mass Gravesite: Spectral Blade (bypasses armour), Wail of the Grave (terrifies everyone near), raises tomb skeletons.

abilities.name: Spectral Blade
abilities.message: %s's spectral blade passes through your armour!

abilities.name: Wail of the Grave
abilities.say: %s lets out a wail from beyond the grave!

abilities.name: Rise, Soldiers
abilities.message: %s calls the buried soldiers to rise!

takmajir_bladestorm.special_ability: Group: the Spymaster's bodyguards. Whirling Blades hits everyone near; bleeding cuts.

abilities.name: Whirling Blades
abilities.say: %s spins into a storm of blades!

takmajir_spymaster.special_ability: Group boss: Shadowstep Strike, Poisoned Mind (silence), calls bladestorms.

abilities.name: Shadowstep Strike
abilities.message: %s steps out of your shadow and strikes!

abilities.name: Poisoned Mind
abilities.message: Your thoughts scatter: you can't find the words of your spells!

abilities.name: To Me, Blades
abilities.message: %s snaps her fingers: a bladestorm answers!

dustwalker_commander.special_ability: Group boss: Shield Bash (stun-daze), Hamstring (snare), bleeding cuts, Void Bolt; calls raiders.

abilities.name: Hamstring
abilities.message: %s cuts the back of your leg!

djhanid_warden.special_ability: Commander of the clans in Ashfall (group): Sunfire Spear, Rallying Cry, and the guardians answer. Wary, not hostile.

abilities.name: Rallying Cry
abilities.message: %s raises the war-spear and fights on renewed!
